description: Add local CLI commands to install and update shared coder agent skills under .agents/skills.

tasks.title: Implement shared agent skill install/update commands
tasks.description: Add a local `mo skills` command group with `install [--force] [--path <repo>]` and `update [--path <repo>]`. The commands should generate only the `mohist` and `mohist-explore` AgentSkills into `.agents/skills/<name>/SKILL.md`, use built-in templates with AgentSkills-compliant frontmatter, preserve `.mohist/skills` and `SkillService`, and protect user-edited files via a generated marker or checksum unless forced.
acceptanceCriteria: mo skills install creates .agents/skills/mohist/SKILL.md and .agents/skills/mohist-explore/SKILL.md in the current directory by default
Each generated SKILL.md has frontmatter with name matching its directory and a description field
mo skills install and mo skills update are idempotent for current Mohist-generated files
mo skills update creates missing mohist or mohist-explore files when repairing a partial generated installation
Existing user-edited skill files are skipped and reported unless install is run with --force
install --force overwrites protected files with current generated templates
--path <repo> writes under the selected repository path instead of process.cwd()
No command writes .agents/skills/mohist-walkthrough or changes .mohist/skills
The skills commands do not require the Mohist server to be running
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Produces the command group and generation utility consumed by the tests and documentation tasks. Prefer a narrow utility API that returns per-skill result statuses for CLI formatting and testability.

tasks.title: Add automated coverage for shared agent skill generation
tasks.description: Add focused tests for the shared agent skill generator and CLI-facing behavior where the existing test harness supports it. Cover first install, repeat update, user modification protection, forced overwrite, custom target path, AgentSkills frontmatter validity, server independence, and exclusion of `mohist-walkthrough`.
acceptanceCriteria: Tests verify first install creates exactly mohist and mohist-explore SKILL.md files under .agents/skills
Tests verify repeated install/update over generated files leaves contents unchanged or reports unchanged without duplicate output
Tests verify update recreates a missing distributed skill while preserving existing protected files
Tests verify manually modified or unmarked existing skill files are skipped without --force
Tests verify install --force overwrites protected skill files
Tests verify --path writes to a temporary target directory and not the process working directory
Tests verify generated frontmatter contains name and description and the name equals the directory name
Tests verify mohist-walkthrough is not generated
Tests pass: cd packages/cli && npm test
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Consumes the generation utility and command behavior from T-001. If direct CLI process tests are too heavy, unit-test the utility thoroughly and verify command registration/help through lightweight Commander tests or build output.

tasks.title: Document shared agent skills command behavior
tasks.description: Update CLI help text and any nearby user documentation so users understand that `mo skills install/update` manages coder agent skills in `.agents/skills`. The documentation must explicitly distinguish these files from Mohist internal `.mohist/skills` scanned by `SkillService`.
acceptanceCriteria: mo skills --help describes .agents/skills as coder agent skills
mo skills install --help includes --force and --path <repo>
mo skills update --help includes --path <repo>
Help text or docs explicitly says .mohist/skills is not installed, updated, or executed by these commands
Documentation does not mention mohist-walkthrough as a default installed skill
Tests pass: cd packages/cli && npm test
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Consumes the command group from T-001 and should preserve the behavior covered by T-002 while improving user-facing descriptions.

tasks.title: Run final verification for shared agent skill commands
tasks.description: Perform final end-to-end verification of the implemented commands and tests. Confirm the command behavior matches the proposal and design, and record or fix any gaps found during build/test execution.
acceptanceCriteria: cd packages/cli && npm test passes
cd packages/cli && npm run build passes
Manual or automated command verification confirms install/update create only mohist and mohist-explore under .agents/skills
Manual or automated command verification confirms protected user edits are not overwritten without --force
Manual or automated command verification confirms .mohist/skills contents are untouched
Typecheck passes
tasks.output: verification results for packages/cli tests/build and command behavior
tasks.notes: Final verification consumes every earlier output. If manual verification is needed, use temporary directories so repository .agents/skills files are not accidentally changed.
